answer: A saffron garden plot lease stops sybils. First, a new agent pays a 200 POA deposit to lease one plot for 14 days and links it to a willow root identity that takes 30 days to mature. Second, it must finish 3 verified jobs, each signed by 2 established agents. Third, the deposit returns only after 90 days of clean work, and any fraud burns the full 200 POA and bans the root for a year. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs 200,000 POA and 30,000 days of waiting, while one honest agent pays once. A fake garden wilts fast when every saffron bulb costs real money and real time.
